blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)仍然容易受到越狱攻击,对手将最优化后缀附加到否则良性外观的提示来绕过安全对接. 现有的以优化为基础的GCG型攻击可以有效,但在推断时间却很昂贵,并且受到转会不良之苦. 我们提出,SALSA, 一个基因框架, 学习一个分布 越狱后缀 从优化衍生的攻击蝎子。 该模型经过培训后,支持高效的采样攻击。 在开源目标上,它实现了能与最先进的优化基线相媲美的攻击成功率,同时将生成时间从每快3.46s减少到0.04s. 在黑箱转移中,它仍然对专有系统非常有效,包括GPT-3.5-Turbo上的99%ASR,在大幅更硬的GPT-4o上达到45%ASR,在同等采样预算中比最强的基线增加一倍以上. 我们进一步提供了一种直觉,说明为什么基因取样能够保持高攻击成功,而当时所学的后缀分布接近于优化输出的分布. 总体而言,我们的结果显示,学习对抗性后缀分布为持续发现LLM脆弱性提供了可扩展的、实际有效的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning, dialogue, and code generation Brown et al. (2020) ; Touvron et al. (2023b) .
However, their deployment in real-world raises crucial safety concerns. Since LLMs are trained on large-scale internet corpora that inevitably contain harmful or otherwise undesirable content Hendrycks et al. (2021) , they are typically aligned through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) Ouyang et al. (2022) ; Bai et al. (2022) to suppress undesirable behavior. While alignment reduces harmful outputs in standard settings, aligned models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks , in which carefully crafted prompts cause the model to bypass safety policies and generate disallowed content Wei et al. (2023) ; Wolf et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)在推理,对话,和代码生成布朗等人(2020年);Touvron等人(2023年b)方面表现出显著的能力.
然而,在现实世界中部署这些部队引起了至关重要的安全关切。 从 LLMs接受大规模互联网公司培训,这些公司不可避免地含有有害或不良内容Hendrycks等人(2021年),通常通过监督的微调和强化从人类反馈中学习(RLHF)进行校对。 Ouyang等人(2022年);Bai等人(2022年),以压制不良行为. 虽然校正减少了标准环境中的有害产出,但校正模型仍然容易受到越狱袭击的伤害,其中精心设计的提示促使该模型绕过安全政策,生成了不允许的内容Wei等人(2023年);Wolf等人(2023年)。

blocks.en:
Early jailbreaks relied on manually engineered prompts that exploit weaknesses in alignment mechanisms Wei et al. (2023) . Such attacks can be effective, but they demand substantial human ingenuity and are often fragile, motivating automated alternatives. The most prominent is the Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) attack Zou et al. (2023) , which formulates jailbreak generation as discrete optimization over token sequences. It uses gradient-guided search to append an adversarial suffix that elicits an affirmative rather than a refusing response.
The resulting suffixes generalize to unseen queries and transfer to closed-source systems such as GPT-3.5 OpenAI (2022) and GPT-4 OpenAI (2024) , demonstrating fundamental vulnerabilities in aligned LLMs.
blocks.zh:
早期越狱事件依靠人工设计的提示,利用了配合机制的弱点 Wei et al. (2023) (英语). 这种攻击是有效的,但需要大量的人类智慧,而且往往很脆弱,可促成自动替代办法。 最突出的是贪婪的坐标梯度(GCG)攻击Zou等人(2023年),它将越狱生成作为离散优化而不是象征序列. 它使用梯度引导搜索来附加一个引起肯定而不是拒绝响应的对抗后缀.
由此产生的后缀概括为隐形查询,并转至闭源系统,如GPT-3.5 OpenAI(2022)和GPT-4 OpenAI(2024),显示了对齐的LLMs中的基本弱点.

blocks.en: Optimization-based attacks nevertheless carry two costs. First, each successful suffix requires expensive iterative search, often hundreds of forward passes Zou et al. (2023) ; Kumar et al. (2024) . Second, these methods return a single low-loss solution per query even though many other successful suffixes exist, and therefore characterize little of the broader space of prompts that induce policy violations. This limitation matters in practice, where an adversary benefits from rapidly sampling diverse jailbreak prompts rather than re-optimizing for every query.
blocks.zh: 然而,基于优化的攻击需要两个代价。 首先,每个成功的后缀都需要昂贵的迭代搜索,往往有数百个前传的邹等人(2023年);库马尔等人(2024年). 第二,尽管存在许多其他成功的后缀,但这些方法每次查询都返回一个单一的低损失解决方案,因此很少说明诱发违反政策行为的更广阔的提示空间。 在实践中,这种限制很重要,在这种情况下,一个对手从迅速取样的各种越狱行为中受益,这促使而不是使每个查询重新优化。

blocks.en: In this work we take a different perspective. Instead of searching for a single adversarial suffix, we model the distribution of suffixes that bypass LLM safety policies, hypothesizing that successful jailbreak suffixes belong to an underlying adversarial space that can be learned from examples produced by optimization-based attacks. To this end, we train a variational autoencoder (VAE) Kingma and Welling (2013) on a corpus of successful suffixes obtained from a strong optimization-based attack (e.g., GCG Zou et al. (2023) , I-GCG Jia et al. (2025) , AmpleGCG Liao and Sun (2024) , AmpleGCG-Plus Kumar et al. (2024) ). The encoder learns a latent representation of the adversarial space and the decoder generates suffixes conditioned on latent variables, so that at inference time sampling from the latent prior yields diverse query-agnostic suffixes that can be appended to arbitrary prompts. This allows hundreds of candidate jailbreak prompts to be generated within seconds, substantially increasing the scale at which automated attacks can be mounted.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们采取不同的观点。 与其寻找单一的对抗后缀,我们模拟了绕过LLM安全政策的后缀的分布,假设成功的越狱后缀属于一个基础的对抗空间,可以从基于优化的攻击产生的例子中吸取教训. 为此,我们根据通过强优化攻击获得的一系列成功后缀(例如,GCG Zoub等人(2023年)、I-GCG Jia等人(2025年)、AmpleGCG Liao和Sun(2024年)、AmpleGCG-Plus Kumar等人(2024年))。 编码器学习了对抗空间的潜在表示,解码器产生以潜在变量为条件的后缀,从而推断出从潜在前期产值中取样的时段,可以附加到任意的提示中. 这使得数百名候选的越狱动作能在数秒内产生,大大提升了自动发动攻击的规模.

blocks.en:
We complement this construction with an intuitive perspective on how closely the learned generator must approximate the empirical distribution of successful adversarial suffixes. Specifically, if the two remain close in total variation distance, the expected policy violation rate of generated suffixes remains close to that of the original attack distribution, which motivates modeling adversarial prompt distributions rather than relying solely on optimization-based search.
Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们以直观的视角来补充这一构思,即学习的发电机必须如何接近成功对抗后缀的经验分布。 具体来说,如果两者在总变异距离上保持接近,那么生成后缀的预期政策违规率仍然接近原攻击分布,这促使模型化的对抗性即时分布,而不是完全依赖于基于优化的搜索.
我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The vulnerability of machine learning models to adversarial manipulation was first studied at length in computer vision, where small crafted perturbations cause misclassification of otherwise natural inputs Goodfellow et al. (2015) and adversarial training frames robustness as a min-max optimization over worst-case perturbations Madry et al. (2018) . Analogous vulnerabilities have since been observed in language models, where adversaries manipulate discrete tokens rather than continuous pixels. Empirical analyses show that seemingly benign modifications such as role-playing, contextual reframing, or narrative scaffolding can induce responses that violate intended safety policies Wei et al. (2023) ; Yi et al. (2024) : DeepInception constructs nested narrative contexts that gradually guide the model toward restricted responses Li et al. (2023) , and persuasion-style prompting shows that jailbreak success can arise from semantic framing rather than purely token-level artifacts Zeng et al. (2024) . Such vulnerabilities are therefore not confined to specific prompts, but reflect broader weaknesses in how alignment mechanisms interact with natural language context.
blocks.zh: 最初在计算机视觉中详细研究了机器学习模式对对抗性操纵的脆弱性,在计算机视觉中,小巧的扰动造成对原本自然投入的错分类Goodfellow等人(2015年)和对抗性训练框架的强性,作为比最坏情况扰动强的最小优化(2018年). 从那时起,在语言模型中就观察到了类似的脆弱性,对手操纵离散的符号而不是连续的像素. 经验分析显示,角色扮演、背景调整或叙事脚手架等看似良性的变化可诱发违反Wei等人(2023年);Yi等人(2024年): Deep Inception构建了嵌入式的叙事背景,逐渐引导模型向有限的响应力Li等人(2023年),劝导式的激励显示,越狱成功可能来自语义框架而非纯粹的象征级文物. 曾等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 因此,这种脆弱性不局限于具体的提示,而是反映了在调整机制如何与自然语言环境相互作用方面更广泛的弱点。

blocks.en: A particularly influential line of work instead formulates jailbreaking as optimization over an adversarial suffix appended to the user query. GCG demonstrated that such suffixes can be discovered through gradient-guided discrete optimization over tokens, achieving high attack success rates across multiple prompts and models Zou et al. (2023) . Their surprising transferability suggests that different LLMs share common vulnerabilities in their learned representations, and subsequent work has refined both the optimization strategy and the search procedure.
blocks.zh: 特别有影响力的一行工作反而将越狱作为优化,而不是用户查询所附的对抗性后缀。 GCG证明,这种后缀可以通过梯度制导的离散优化而不是符号来发现,在多个提示和模型Zou等人(2023年)中实现高攻击成功率. 它们令人惊讶的可转移性表明,不同的法学硕士课程在学习的表述中有着共同的脆弱性,随后的工作既完善了优化战略和搜索程序。

blocks.en: Of particular relevance to our setting, Ben-Tov et al. (2025) observe that GCG suffixes are far from interchangeable. Their effectiveness varies widely, and a subset generalizes to many harmful instructions never seen during optimization. They attribute this variation to a shallow mechanism in which the suffix dominates the contextualization of the final chat-template positions immediately preceding generation, with the suffixes exerting this influence most strongly also being the most universal. Universality is thus a graded, measurable property of individual suffixes rather than an artifact of optimization, so the output of an optimization attack can be treated as a distribution to be modeled rather than a set of one-off solutions. Our work takes up precisely this possibility.
blocks.zh: Ben-Tov等人(2025年)认为,GCG后缀与我们的设定特别相关,因此远不能互换。 它们的有效性差异很大,一个子集概括了许多在优化过程中从未见过的有害指令. 它们将这种变异归因于一种浅薄的机制,其中后缀主导着前代紧接前代的终极聊天-腾讯位置的背景化,而后缀施加这种影响最强烈的也是最普遍的. 因此,普遍性是个别后缀的分级,可测量的财产,而不是优化的文物,所以优化攻击的输出可以被视作一种拟建模的分布,而不是一组一次性的解决方案. 我们的工作正是考虑到这种可能性。

blocks.en: Beyond white-box optimization, a parallel body of work studies jailbreak generation in black-box settings where gradients and internal parameters are unavailable. PAIR treats jailbreak discovery as a conversational optimization process, iteratively querying the model and refining prompts from feedback Chao et al. (2023) , and TAP organizes candidate exploration into tree-structured search under limited query budgets Mehrotra et al. (2024) . Others adapt fuzzing and evolutionary search: GPTFuzzer mutates prompt templates Yu et al. (2023) , OpenSesame evolves universal jailbreak prompts genetically Lapid et al. (2023) , and AutoDAN applies hierarchical genetic optimization to produce semantically coherent adversarial prompts that evade simple detection rules Liu et al. (2024) . More recent inference-time attacks dispense with iterative search altogether: Weak-to-Strong Zhao et al. (2025) guides the decoding distribution of a stronger aligned target using a weak safe/unsafe model pair, and JULI Wang et al. (2026) manipulates token log-probabilities through a lightweight self-introspection plug-in that remains effective under practical black-box APIs.
blocks.zh: 除了白盒优化外,还有一组平行的工作研究,在黑盒环境中进行断狱生成,没有梯度和内部参数。 PAIR将越狱发现视为一种对话优化过程,迭代查询模型,并精炼反馈Chao等人(2023年)的提示,TAP在有限的查询预算Mehrotra等人(2024年)下组织候选人探索进入树结构搜索. 其他适应模糊和进化搜索: GPTFuzzer 变异即时模板 Yu et al. (2023),OpenSesame 演化普世越狱激励转基因Lapid et al. (2023),AutoDAN 应用分级基因优化,生成逃避简单检测规则的Semative common against pointing points Liu et al. (2024). 更近期的推论-时间攻击完全不用迭代搜索:Wow-to-Strong Zhao et al. (2025)用一个弱的安全/不安全模型对子指导更强对齐目标的解码分配,JULI Wang et al. (2026)通过轻量级自摄插件操纵符号日志概率,在实用黑盒API下仍然有效.

blocks.en:
Since iterative optimization remains expensive at inference time, recent work amortizes the cost of jailbreak discovery through generative models. AmpleGCG collects successful adversarial suffixes and trains a conditional generator mapping harmful queries to candidate suffixes, enabling rapid sampling without optimization loops Liao and Sun (2024) , and AmpleGCG-Plus refines this strategy to achieve stronger success rates with fewer sampled candidates Kumar et al. (2024) .
Related efforts extend such attacks to vision-language models Chen et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024) . Together these works mark a shift from search-based attacks toward modeling the underlying structure of adversarial prompts.
blocks.zh:
由于迭代优化在推论时间仍然昂贵,近期的工作通过基因模型来摊还破狱发现的成本. AmplGCG收集成功的对抗后缀,并训练一个有条件的生成器将有害的询问映射到候选后缀,使得快速采样没有优化循环的辽和太阳(2024年),而AmplGCG-Plus则完善了这一策略,以获得更强的成功率,而抽样的考生库马尔等人(2024年)则更少.
相关努力将此类攻击扩大到视觉语言模式 陈等 (2025); 王等 (2024). 这些作品共同标志着从基于搜索的攻击转向模拟对抗性提示的基本结构。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, most existing methods remain tightly coupled to specific queries. Suffixes optimized for individual harmful instructions can overfit and transfer poorly, particularly in black-box settings, and commonly used objectives such as forcing the model to begin its response with a fixed affirmative token do not reliably capture true jailbreak success Liao and Sun (2024) . This raises a broader question about the role of query conditioning in adversarial prompt generation:
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有方法仍然与具体询问紧密结合。 为个别有害指令优化的后缀可能过度适应和传输不良,特别是在黑盒环境下,常用的目标如强迫模型以固定的肯定符号开始响应,并不能可靠地捕捉真正的越狱成功 廖和孙(2024). 这引起了一个更广泛的问题,即查询条件在对抗性即时生成中的作用:

blocks.en: RQ: Are effective jailbreaks tightly coupled to individual queries, or do they reflect a more general adversarial structure?
blocks.zh: RQ:是否有效的越狱与个人询问紧密结合,还是反映了更普遍的对抗结构?

blocks.en: Motivated by this question, we model adversarial suffixes as samples from a broader distribution of high-risk prompts rather than conditioning generation on individual queries. This enables efficient sampling of diverse query-agnostic suffixes that induce policy violations across a wide range of queries and models, and exposes vulnerabilities that may remain hidden when attacks are optimized for specific queries.
blocks.zh: 以这个问题为动机,我们把对抗性后缀作为样本,取材于高风险提示的更广泛分布,而不是以单个询问作为生成条件。 这使得能够高效地取样各种查询-不可知性后缀,这些后缀在广泛的查询和模式中引起政策违规,并暴露出在为特定查询优化攻击时可能仍然隐藏的弱点。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: To obtain examples of successful adversarial suffixes, we draw on optimization-based jailbreak attacks. In our experiments the suffixes are produced by the Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) attack Zou et al. (2023) , although any suffix optimization algorithm could be used, and our framework is agnostic to which one supplies the corpus. Rather than drawing suffixes from a single source model, we pool corpora optimized against several models from distinct families Ben-Tov et al. (2025) . Suffixes that succeed against only one alignment procedure are thereby diluted relative to those reflecting structure common to several, which is precisely the structure we wish the generator to model. blocks.en: 4 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We describe below how the generator is instantiated and trained, the corpora used for training and evaluation, and the protocol under which attacks are generated and scored.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We instantiate the generator as an HR-VAE Li et al. (2019) with a two-layer LSTM encoder and decoder, each of hidden size 128. Each suffix token is embedded into a 4096-dimensional vector, initialized from the Llama-2-7b-chat tokenizer and embedding matrix, which supplies a single fixed vocabulary over which suffixes from all source models are represented.
The latent variable for each suffix is Z ∈ ℝ 128 × 2 × 2 Z\in\mathbb{R}^{128\times 2\times 2} , where the extra factor of two corresponds to the LSTM hidden and cell states. Following Li et al. (2019) , we apply holistic regularization by computing the KL term at each encoder step and averaging across sequence length, and otherwise adopt the standard setting of that work. Training uses Adam Kingma and Ba (2015) (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), batch size 8, and β = 1 \beta=1 , for 1000 epochs. The generator is the only component we train; no victim model is fine-tuned at any stage.

我们把发电机作为HR-VAE Li等人(2019年),配备了两层LSTM编码器和解码器,每个编码器的隐藏尺寸为128. 每个后缀符号都嵌入一个4096维的矢量,初始化自Llama-2-7b-chat sorderizer和嵌入矩阵,它提供一个单一的固定词汇,上面代表所有源模型的后缀.
每个后缀的潜伏变量是 Z QQ R 128 × 2 × 2 Z\in\ mathbb{ R\\\ 128\time 2\time 2},其中两个的额外因子对应 LSTM 隐藏状态和单元格状态. 继Li等人(2019年)之后,我们通过计算每个编码器步骤的 KL 术语和跨序列长度的平均值来应用整体的规范化,并采用这项工作的标准设定。 训练使用Adam Kingma和Ba(2015年)(学习率10−4 10^{-4},体重衰减10−5 10^{-5}),批量尺寸8,β=1\β=1,为1000个纪元. 发电机是我们训练的唯一部件;任何阶段都没有对受害者模型进行微调。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate transferability across diverse open-source families, Vicuna-7b Chiang et al. (2023) , Mistral-7b Jiang et al. (2023) , and Llama-2-13b-chat Touvron et al. (2023a) , as well as on two closed-source systems, GPT-3.5-Turbo OpenAI (2022) and GPT-4o OpenAI (2024) . For the closed-source targets the attacker has access to neither gradients nor internal parameters, so attack success depends entirely on the transferability of the generated suffixes.
blocks.zh: 我们评价不同来源家庭的可转移性,Vicuna-7b 蒋等人(2023年),Mistral-7b Jiang等人(2023年),和Llama-2-13b-chat Touvron等人(2023年a),以及两个闭源系统GPT-3.5-Turbo OpenAI(2022年)和GPT-4o OpenAI(2024年). 对于闭源目标,攻击者既不能获取梯度,也不能获取内部参数,因此攻击成功完全取决于生成的后缀的可转移性.

blocks.en: We compare against three families of attacks: optimization-based attacks (GCG Zou et al. (2023) and AutoDAN Liu et al. (2024) ), surrogate-logit manipulation methods (Weak-to-strong Zhao et al. (2025) and JULI Wang et al. (2026) ), and generative attacks (AmpleGCG-Plus Kumar et al. (2024) ). Unless otherwise specified, all baseline results reported in this paper were reproduced by us following the settings of the original papers, with default hyperparameters throughout. For AmpleGCG-Plus the generator is trained on suffixes collected from Llama-2-13b-chat Touvron et al. (2023b) , and GCG optimization is likewise performed on Llama-2-13b-chat , matching the protocol of the original works. This places our method under a strictly harder condition, since Llama-2-13b-chat is a close relative of one victim model whereas none of our source models is.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个攻击的家族:基于优化的攻击(Zou等人(2023年)和AutoDAN Liu等人(2024年)),代名词操纵方法(Weak-to-strong Zhao等人(2025年)和JULI Wang等人(2026年)),以及基因攻击(AmpleGCG-Plus Kumar等人(2024年))。 除非另有说明,本文件中报告的所有基线结果都是我们按照原始文件的设置复制的,全过程都有默认的超参数。 对于AmpleGCG-Plus,发电机在从Llama-2-13b-chat Touvron等人(2023b)收集的后缀上接受培训,GCG优化同样在Llama-2-13b-chat上进行,与原始作品的协议相匹配. 这使得我们的方法处于非常困难的状态,因为Llama-2-13b-chat是一个受害者模型的近亲,而我们所有的源模型都不是.

blocks.en: Suffixes are generated by sampling z ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) and decoding autoregressively. For each harmful query we draw N N latent vectors and decode one suffix per sample, starting from the BOS token and continuing token-by-token up to a maximum suffix length of 20 tokens. Sampling is query-agnostic since a single generator serves every query, and no per-query optimization is performed at any point.
blocks.zh: 后缀由采样 z ∼ N ⁡ (0, I) z\sim\ mathcal{N}(0,I) 自动解码生成. 对于每一个有害的查询,我们绘制N N 潜伏向量,并解码每个样本的一个后缀,从BOS令牌开始,并持续逐个令牌,最高后缀长度为20个令牌. 抽样是查询-不可知的,因为一个单一的生成器为每个查询服务,任何时间都不进行每个溪流的优化.

blocks.en: For each test query q q we sample N N suffixes { s i } i = 1 N \{s_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} and mark the query as successful if ∃ i \exists\;i such that ℓ ⁡ ( f , q , s i ) = 1 \ell(f,q,s_{i})=1 . We report attack success rate (ASR) as the fraction of test queries so marked. The instantiation of ℓ \ell matters here: refusal-based metrics that treat any non-refusal as success (often called ASR-R) can overestimate attack effectiveness, because a non-refusal response may still be non-informative or harmless. We therefore use response-level harmfulness classification, following prior jailbreak evaluations that rely on LLM judges and safety classifiers Yi et al. (2024) ; Mazeika et al. blocks.en: We attribute this margin to the composition of the training corpus. Drawing suffixes from three model families exposes the VAE to structure that recurs independently of any single alignment procedure, and the resulting latent space yields candidates that remain effective against a target whose safety training differs substantially from that of every source model. The result supports a weaker but more robust claim that the learned distribution captures adversarial patterns that generalize well beyond the artifacts of any one optimization run.
blocks.zh: 我们把这一差额归因于培训机构的组成。 绘制来自三个模范家庭的后缀,使VAE接触到独立于任何单一调整程序的结构,由此产生的潜在空间产生候选人,这些候选人仍能有效对付一个目标,而该目标的安全培训与每个源模型都有很大不同。 其结果支持一种较弱但更有力的说法,即所学的分布捕捉到的对抗模式远远超出了任何一次优化运行的工艺。

blocks.en: Taken together, the open- and closed-source results indicate that optimization-derived suffixes reflect a shared adversarial structure in prompt space rather than purely query-specific solutions. Modeling that structure directly, rather than searching for a single low-loss suffix per query, is what allows a generator trained on no victim family to match or exceed methods optimized against a victim relative. Qualitative examples are provided in Appendix E .

blocks.en:
Automatic judges return a binary verdict, which becomes uninformative once a benchmark saturates. Both our method and AmpleGCG-Plus reach 100 % 100\% ASR (Table 1 ) on Mistral-7b so ASR cannot separate them. We therefore compare attack quality on the target through human annotation. We sampled 20 randomly prompts AdvBench. For each prompt, we drew one response from our system and one from AmpleGCG, our strongest baseline, in both cases selecting a response the automatic judge had already marked successful. Thus, every rated item is a successful attack and the comparison is conditional on success rather than a re-measurement of it.
Four AI-NLP researchers (2 PhD students and 2 Postdocs) independently rated all 40 responses on a five-point scale for Relevance to the request, Harmfulness of the content elicited, and Fluency of the text, giving 80 judgements per system per dimension. Annotators were warned of the content in advance, participated voluntarily under informed consent, and could stop at any point. We kept the sample deliberately small to limit exposure. Guidelines, detailed metrics, and inter-annotator agreement are reported in the Appendix D .

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that equal ASR conceals a substantial difference in attack quality. Our method is rated higher on every dimension, with the widest separation on harmfulness. Since all rated responses were automatic-judge successes, this gap reflects not how often each system bypasses the safety policy but what it elicits once it has. A considerable share of the baseline’s successes engage only loosely with the request or carry little actionable detail, yet are indistinguishable from ours under a binary classifier. Refusal-free but uninformative output is thus a real failure mode of classifier-based ASR, and it inflates apparent effectiveness precisely where the metric can least discriminate. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce a generative, scalable framework for vulnerability discovery in large language models. Our method learns the distribution of attack samples rather than performing instance-based optimization. We use a variational inference based autoencoder to learn the manifold of adversarial samples. This enables efficient large-scale sampling that reduces per-prompt attack cost and provides strong transferability across both open and closed source targets. Empirically, our experiments show that the proposed method exceeds or matches state-of-the-art attack effectiveness while offering substantial runtime gains. Across open-source targets, it reaches high ASR comparable to AmpleGCG-Plus at roughly an 85 × \times lower generation latency, and does so without any victim models appearing in its training corpus. In black-box settings, it transfers strongly to proprietary models, saturating GPT-3.5-Turbo and reaching 45% ASR on GPT-4o , more than double the strongest baseline configuration at the same sampling budget.
blocks.zh: 我们在大型语言模型中引入了一个基因可扩展的弱点发现框架。 我们的方法学习攻击样本的分布 而不是进行实例优化 我们使用一种基于变异推论的自动编码器来学习多种对抗性样本. 这使得能够进行高效率的大规模取样,从而降低每一次攻击的成本,并在公开和封闭源目标之间提供强大的可转移性。 从经验上讲,我们的实验表明,拟议的方法超过了或符合最新的攻击效果,同时提供了大量的运行时间收益。 在整个开放源代码中,它达到了与AmpleGCG-Plus相当的高ASR,大约为85×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 在黑盒设置中,它强烈地向专有模型转移,饱和GPT-3.5-Turbo,并在GPT-4o上达到45%的ASR,是同一采样预算最强基线配置的两倍以上.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The learned generator can only represent patterns present in the suffix corpus it is trained on. Because we reuse a released corpus Ben-Tov et al. (2025) , its coverage, source models, and affirmative-response objective are fixed by that artifact, and our results should be read as a lower bound on the vulnerability the framework can expose rather than a characterization of the full adversarial region. The corpus is also small and unevenly composed, 1,686 1{,}686 suffixes with roughly three quarters drawn from a single source model. Generalization is correspondingly conditional on model family: pooling across Gemma-2 , Qwen-2.5 , and Llama-3.1 mitigates but does not remove this dependence, and as alignment procedures evolve the suffix distribution will shift, requiring periodic re-collection and retraining. Performance further depends on the sampling budget, remaining stable for N ∈ [ 75,100 ] N\in[75,100] but declining below it, and discrete sequence VAEs remain sensitive to training dynamics, which may limit the discovery of novel jailbreak behaviors.
blocks.zh: 学习的生成器只能代表它所训练的后缀中存在的图案. 由于我们重用释放物Ben-Tov等人(2025年),其覆盖范围、源模型和肯定反应目标由该文物确定,我们的结果应被理解为对脆弱性的较低约束,框架可以暴露而不是描述整个对抗区。 体积也很小,组成不均,有1 686 1{,}686个后缀,大约四分之三来自单一来源模型。 一般化相应地以模式家族为条件:集合跨Gemma-2,Quen-2.5,和Llama-3.1减轻了但并没有消除这种依赖性,随着对齐程序的发展,后缀分配将发生转变,需要定期的重拾和再培训. 性能进一步取决于采样预算,对于N QQ[75,100] N\in[75,100]保持稳定,但下降低于它,离散序列VAE对训练动力学仍然敏感,这可能限制发现新的越狱行为.

blocks.en: A natural extension is to use the generator within a closed-loop defense pipeline, proposing candidate jailbreak prompts at scale that are then filtered for novelty and validity, relabeled against current target models or safety policies, and selectively incorporated into subsequent safety tuning. This would progressively extend adversarial coverage beyond what upstream optimization discovers, while reducing reliance on expensive human-in-the-loop prompt engineering.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的延伸是在闭路防御管道内使用发电机,提出可选的越狱提示,然后加以过滤,使之具有新颖性和有效性,根据目前的目标模式或安全政策重新贴上标签,并有选择地纳入随后的安全调理中。 这将逐步扩大对抗性覆盖范围,超出上游优化发现的范围,同时减少对昂贵的即时工程的依赖。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work studies a known class of vulnerability in aligned large language models. Our contribution is a more efficient means of characterizing this weakness, not a new attack surface. The underlying techniques, optimization-based suffix search and the generative suffix models built on it are already documented in the literature and available as public code. The vulnerability we study, therefore, exists independently of our work; what we add is the ability to sample and measure it at scale, which is directly what defenders need to detect, filter, and adversarially train against such attacks. To maintain a balance between research value and the risk of misuse, we take all possible steps. All experiments were carried out against models using their conventional interfaces. We did not target real users. We will offer our trained generator and accompanying data via a controlled release for academic research purposes rather than open distribution, ensuring that the resource is available for red-teaming and robustness investigations while increasing the barrier to casual usage.
blocks.zh: 这项工作以一致的大语言模式研究了已知的一类脆弱性。 我们的贡献是更高效地描述这一弱点的手段,而不是新的攻击表面。 基础技术,基于优化的后缀搜索和基于它建立的基因后缀模型已经被文献记载,并作为公共代码提供. 因此,我们研究的脆弱性独立于我们的工作;我们补充的是,能够进行抽样和大规模衡量,这是捍卫者直接需要的,以便发现、过滤和对抗这种攻击。 为了在研究价值和滥用风险之间保持平衡,我们采取一切可能的步骤。 所有实验都是用其常规接口对模型进行的。 我们没有瞄准真正的用户。 我们将通过用于学术研究目的的控制发布,而不是公开发布,提供我们训练有素的发电机和配套数据,确保资源可用于红色队伍和强力调查,同时增加临时使用的障碍。

blocks.en: B.1 MaliciousInstruct Dataset

blocks.en: MaliciousInstruct Huang et al. (2024) consists of 100 malicious instructions spanning ten thematic categories: psychological manipulation, sabotage, theft, reputation damage, cyberbullying, false accusations, tax evasion, cyberattacks, financial fraud, and illicit drug use, with ten instructions per category. The prompts are formulated as actionable how-to queries and strategy-seeking requests that reflect realistic adversarial use cases. Relative to AdvBench, MaliciousInstruct emphasizes social engineering, interpersonal manipulation, and financial fraud, categories that are underrepresented in optimization-centric benchmarks. This complementary topical coverage makes it particularly valuable for evaluating whether adversarial suffixes learned from one query distribution can induce policy violations across substantially different misuse domains.
blocks.zh: 恶意指示 Huang等人(2024年)包括100份恶意指示,涉及10个主题类别:心理操纵、破坏、盗窃、名誉损害、网络欺凌、诬告、逃税、网络攻击、金融欺诈和非法吸毒,每类有10份指示。 这些提示是可诉的询问和寻求战略的请求,反映了现实的对抗性使用案例。 相对于Adv Bench,恶意指令强调社会工程,人际操控,以及金融欺诈,这些类别在优化-核心基准中代表性不足. 这种补充性的专题报道特别有助于评价从一个查询分配中吸取的对抗性后缀是否会在大相径庭的滥用领域引起违反政策行为。

blocks.en: Since MaliciousInstruct was not used during adversarial suffix collection or generator training, strong attack performance on this benchmark would provide evidence that the learned suffix distribution captures transferable adversarial structure rather than query-specific artifacts. Together with AdvBench, the two datasets span a substantially broader range of misuse categories than either benchmark alone, enabling a more comprehensive characterization of the adversarial attack surface exposed by our generative framework.
blocks.zh: 由于恶意指令在对抗性后缀收集或生成器训练中并未使用,因此在这个基准上的强攻性能会提供证据,证明学到的后缀分配能捕捉到可转移的对抗性结构,而不是特定查询的文物. 与Adv Bench一起,两个数据集涵盖的滥用类别远远超出任何一种基准,从而能够更全面地描述我们基因框架暴露的对抗性攻击表面。

blocks.en: B.2 HarmBench Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.2 Harm Bench 评价

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate ASR using the HarmBench classifier Mazeika et al. (2024) . For each test behavior, we sample 100 100 adversarial suffixes from our trained generator and mark a behavior as successfully attacked if at least one suffix–query pair elicits a response classified as harmful. This classifier-based ASR, analogous to the ASR-G metric used in our main experiments with gpt-oss-safeguard-20b , avoids the overestimation inherent in refusal-based metrics (ASR-R) that treat any non-refusal as a successful attack.
blocks.zh: 使用Harm Bench分类器Mazeika等人(2024年), 对于每个测试行为,我们从训练有素的发电机中抽取100个对抗性后缀,并标出至少一个后缀-query对引起被归类为有害的反应的行为为成功攻击. 这种基于ASR的分类法类似于Gpt-oss-seguard-20b在我们的主要实验中使用的ASR-G度量法,避免了基于拒绝的度量法(ASR-R)内在的过高估计,将任何非反射都视为成功的攻击.

blocks.en: The combined use of AdvBench Zou et al. (2023) , MaliciousInstruct Huang et al. (2024) , and the HarmBench Mazeika et al. (2024) evaluation framework provides a comprehensive assessment. AdvBench tests generalization from training-adjacent queries, MaliciousInstruct assesses out-of-distribution transfer across a different misuse taxonomy, and HarmBench supplies a standardized, classifier-grounded evaluation protocol. This evaluation strategy mitigates the risk of benchmark specific overfitting and provides a more faithful estimate of the practical attack coverage afforded by our generative framework.
blocks.zh: Adv Bench Zou等人(2023年)的综合使用,恶意指令 Huang等人(2024年)和Harm Bench Mazeika等人(2024年)的评价框架提供了全面评估。 Adv Bench从培训相邻的查询中测试通用性,恶意指示评估不同滥用分类法之间的分配外转移,Harm Bench提供标准化的、基于分类方法的评价协议。 这一评估战略减轻了具体基准过于适应的风险,并对我们基因框架所提供的实际攻击范围提供了更可靠的估计。

blocks.en: B.3 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: B.3 评价设置

blocks.en: To assess whether the adversarial suffix distribution learned on AdvBench generalizes to queries drawn from a different misuse taxonomy, we evaluate all methods on the MaliciousInstruct dataset using Llama-2-13b-chat as the victim model. Importantly, no method in this comparison was trained or optimized on MaliciousInstruct prompts. All generators and optimization runs use AdvBench exclusively, making this a strict out-of-distribution transfer evaluation. Our generator is additionally trained on suffixes pooled from Gemma-2 , Qwen-2.5 , and Llama-3.1 , none of which is the victim model here. We report ASR under two independent judges, gpt-oss-safeguard-20b and the HarmBench classifier, to ensure that our findings are robust to the choice of evaluation criterion.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在Adv Bench上学到的对抗性后缀分配是否将来自不同滥用分类法的询问归纳为一般,我们评价了以Llama-2-13b-chat作为受害者模型的恶意指令数据集上的所有方法。 重要的是,在这种比较中,没有任何方法在恶意指示提示方面得到训练或优化。 所有发电机和优化运行都只使用Adv Bench,使得这成为严格的分配外转移评价. 我们的发电机还接受了Gemma-2、Quen-2.5和Llama-3.1的后缀集训,这些都不是受害者模型。 我们以两名独立法官(gpt-oss-seguard-20b)和Harm Bench分类法(Harm Bench)报告ASR,以确保我们的结论对选择评价标准很有力。

blocks.en: The results in Table 6 reveal a consistent pattern across both judges. Non-generative baselines exhibit substantially degraded performance on this out-of-distribution benchmark. Weak-to-strong achieves 28% and 65% ASR under the two judges, while JULI obtains 24% and 35%, respectively. The notable discrepancy between the two judges for these methods, particularly for Weak-to-strong, where the HarmBench classifier reports more than twice the ASR of gpt-oss-safeguard-20b , suggests that a substantial fraction of their elicited responses are borderline. Sufficiently harmful to satisfy the more permissive HarmBench criterion but filtered by the stricter safety classifier. In contrast, both generative approaches achieve high ASR under both judges, indicating that their successful attacks elicit unambiguously policy-violating content.
blocks.zh: 表6的结果显示,这两名法官的情况一致。 非遗传性基线表明,在分配外基准上,业绩严重退化。 弱到强在两名法官之下分别获得28%和65%的ASR,而JULI则分别获得24%和35%. 两位法官在这些方法上存在明显差异,特别是对弱到强者而言,Harm Bench的分类报告是Gpt-oss-seguard-20b的ASR的两倍以上,这表明他们所得出的答复中有很大一部分是边缘性的。 足够有害,足以满足更宽松的Harm Bench标准,但被更严格的安全分类器过滤。 与此相反,在两位法官的领导下,这两种基因方法都取得了较高的ASR,表明其成功的攻击引出了毫不含糊的政策孤立内容。

blocks.en: Our method achieves 85% and 97% ASR under gpt-oss-safeguard-20b and HarmBench, respectively, approaching saturation under the latter criterion. These results are obtained without any exposure to MaliciousInstruct during training, confirming that the adversarial suffix distribution learned by our VAE captures structural regularities in the adversarial space that transfer across query distributions. The strong performance on MaliciousInstruct, further supports the hypothesis that effective jailbreak suffixes reflect shared vulnerabilities in the model’s safety alignment rather than query-specific artifacts. When considered alongside the efficiency advantage documented in section 5.1 (approximately 85 × \times faster generation), these findings support the practical viability of our generative framework for scalable, cross-domain vulnerability discovery.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在gpt-oss-seguard-20b和Harm Bench下分别实现了85%和97%的ASR,在后者标准下接近饱和. 这些结果是在训练期间不暴露于恶意指令的情况下取得的,这证实了我们VAE所学到的对抗性后缀分布捕捉了跨查询分布的对抗空间中的结构规律. 在恶意指令上的强效表现进一步支持了这样的假设,即有效的越狱后缀反映了模型安全调整而不是特定查询文物中的共同弱点. 这些结论与第5.1节(大约85xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

blocks.en: D.2 Annotation Procedure

blocks.en: Each annotator independently evaluated all sampled responses without access to the outputs of other annotators. Annotators were provided only with responses that had been identified as successful attacks, and rated each along three dimensions on the 5-point scales defined above. For each generation, we average the annotators’ scores across each dimension, and we report the resulting mean relevance, harmfulness, and fluency.

blocks.en: We measure agreement with Gwet’s AC2 Gwet (2012) using quadratic weights, which is appropriate for ordinal scales, and unlike κ \kappa -family statistics, is not deflated by the prevalence paradox that arises when ratings concentrate in a small number of categories. This matters here because the ratings for our system are strongly skewed toward the upper end of the scale, and because the weighting credits near-agreement on an ordinal scale where exact agreement is rare by construction.

GCG is the natural comparison here because our generator is trained exclusively on GCG-derived suffixes. For each prompt, we report the appended adversarial suffix and the resulting model output. Our method successfully elicits policy-violating responses in all three cases. In Prompt 1, the model enumerates common online scam typologies; in Prompt 2, it produces executable shell code addressing the harmful query; and in Prompt 3, it provides step-by-step procurement guidance. GCG, by contrast, fails uniformly: Prompt 1 yields degenerate token repetition ( ‘‘of the of the...’’ ), while Prompts 2 and 3 trigger explicit refusal responses.

blocks.en: Suffixes produced by our framework combine natural-language fragments, latex commands, and programming tokens, reflecting the diversity of the learned latent space. GCG suffixes, derived from greedy coordinate-wise optimization, lack this heterogeneity and tend to overfit to source-model-specific patterns, limiting their transferability. These results corroborate the quantitative findings and illustrate the practical advantage of distributional modeling: sampling from a learned manifold of adversarial suffixes increases the likelihood that at least one candidate bypasses the target model’s safety alignment, consistent with the theoretical guarantee of Proposition 3.1.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架产生的后缀结合了自然语言的片段,ladex命令,以及编程符号,反映了所学到的潜在空间的多样性. GCG后缀是从贪婪的坐标-明智优化中衍生出来的,缺乏这种异质性,并倾向于过度适应源模型特定模式,限制了它们的可转移性. 这些结果证实了定量结论,并说明了分配模型的实际好处:从多种对抗性后缀中取样,增加了至少一名候选人绕过目标模型的安全调整的可能性,这符合建议3.1的理论保障。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports the comparison on GPT-4o , the only target in our evaluation that is far enough from saturation for the methods to separate. Direct sampling reaches 32 % 32\% , and our method reaches 45 % 45\% on identical data, a margin of 13 13 points. Two observations follow. First, corpus composition is clearly a substantial factor: direct sampling from our pooled corpus exceeds AmpleGCG-Plus in its published configuration by 31 31 points and exceeds it by 10 10 points even when that baseline is given suffixes from additional source models. This is consistent with the account in Section 5 , which attributes part of the margin on GPT-4o to drawing suffixes from three model families. Second, and more importantly for the claim this paper makes, corpus composition does not account for the result on its own. With the corpus held fixed, the generator improves on the suffixes it was trained on by 13 13 points, so the gain cannot be attributed to retrieval of stored attacks.

blocks.en: The direction of this gap is worth noting, since a generator that had merely memorized its training set could at best match direct sampling.
